verification.command: Read the pinned ArcNotes files. Replace ArcForges.ArcNotes.Core with ArcForges.Cloud and ArcNotes with Cloud. In BuildIdentity add the embedded package-lock.json input and resolve npm lockfileVersion packages using pkg:npm/<lock-path>, excluding the root entry. In tests remove unused Text/Repository imports and the RehashedSupportReportsCannotChangeSourceOrRun test, which depends on desktop tooling. Compare expected target hashes; independently test Cloud report/assembly/image/candidate tampering in this owner. For the catalog substitute ArcNotes with Cloud, declare NativeFormatVersion not-applicable because this service owns no portable product format, name WP07 and the Cloud persistence owner for storage, and append package-lock.json to PackageVersion sources. Write two-space JSON and final LF. Format the catalog using this owner pinned Prettier 3.9.6 and .prettierrc.json; independent formatting of the transformed original must match exactly. Re-express IdentityEvidence.VerifyAssemblies as BuildMetadataTests: select the three Cloud app/consumer/test paths, assert actual Git source/epoch/dirty and expected CI/local metadata via xUnit, use bounded Git execution, and validate the app compiled report. This owner-specific rewrite is reviewed against the original PE traversal and independently exercised on all three real Cloud assemblies. For AFV2-MIG-01 preserve the exact HOST-03 catalog as eng/version-sources-legacy.json and use it in retained managed fixtures. Verify the current catalog against committed Go dependencies and retain the original source attribution.
verification.expected: Reviewed source transformations, exact target hashes, independent Cloud resolver and three actual assembly checks; no inheritance of ArcNotes runtime acceptance.
